Hero.tagline: I build fast, modern digital products that drive business growth, available for freelance projects worldwide.

WhatIDo.heading: WHAT I DO /
WhatIDo.label: (Services)
WhatIDo.intro: I specialize in building fast, reliable, and user-friendly full-stack digital solutions. I bridge the gap between complex ideas and market-ready products that drive real business value and long-term growth.

services.title: Full-Stack Development
services.description: I build end-to-end solutions, from intuitive frontend experiences to robust backend systems. Focused on web development and leveraging modern tech to build scalable, real-world applications.

services.title: Optimization
services.description: I build systems that scale reliably, applying solid engineering principles to keep applications fast, stable, and future-ready.

services.title: AI-Assisted Development
services.description: I use AI tools to speed up development while maintaining solid engineering standards—supporting everything from rapid prototyping to scalable, well-structured systems.

Works.heading: SELECTED WORKS /
Works.label: (PROJECTS)
Works.intro: Thoughtfully crafted digital experiences that blend utility and aesthetics into something functional, memorable, and refined.

projects.title: My Profolio
projects.summary: A self-designed single-page portfolio that presents full-stack craft and selected work to a global audience. Built with Next.js for localized routing and a contact-form email loop, plus GSAP / Motion / Lenis for smooth scroll and entrance motion.

projects.title: Keyboard Designer
projects.summary: An open-source keycap designer that runs in the browser. Pick a layout, tune colors, place artwork, preview in real-time 3D, and export PNG, SVG, JSON, or production jigs. No sign-up; designs stay in your browser.

projects.title: Hynel Energy
projects.summary: An energy-market analytics and price-forecasting SaaS spanning dashboards, CMS, and subscription payments. Delivers multi-dimensional time-series and map visuals with ECharts and MapLibre, plus JWT / RBAC auth and an Alipay subscription loop.

projects.title: Vehicle Search Script
projects.summary: A desktop vehicle-search tool that batch-imports plates, runs multi-threaded parking lookups, and pushes Telegram alerts on hits. Supports Selenium and pure-HTTP scrapers, proxy pooling with traffic controls, and live status over WebSocket.

About.lead: I'm a full-stack developer and designer dedicated to crafting high-performance digital products that bridge the gap between complex logic and fluid design.
About.p1: Leveraging a versatile stack from React and Node.js to Spring Boot and Python, I build scalable applications that thrive under pressure. Whether it's Web platforms, Mobile apps, or Desktop software, I focus on delivering seamless, end-to-end solutions for startups and businesses.
About.p2: I believe in the power of micro-interactions and refined motion. My approach is simple: engineer for reliability, design for impact, and obsess over the details that elevate a product from functional to exceptional.
